## MockTelegramServer.pendingUpdates property

Inbound updates waiting to be collected by a polling bot's `getUpdates`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
pendingUpdates: Record<string, unknown>[];
```

## Remarks

Real Telegram queues an update until either the webhook delivers it or a polling bot retrieves it. `_postUpdate` covers the webhook half; this queue covers the polling half, so both deploy modes are driven through the same inbound endpoint.
